about: How Noita's numbers become Magicraft's. Anchored on Spark Bolt = Magicraft's Magic Bullet (Noita 800 px/s, 3 HP, 5 mana, 40 frames -> Magicraft 16 m/s, 10 damage, 3 MP, 0.67 s) and Magicraft's level curve.

rows.why: Noita pixel in Magicraft metres (Mina's 19 px = 1.7 m); sizes and explosion radii
damage = damageBase * (NoitaHP/3)^exp, so Noita's huge numbers stay in Magicraft's range
Noita runs at 60 frames per second
longest projectile life in seconds (Magicraft rooms are small)
biggest explosion radius in metres (the Nuke)
an accelerating projectile (negative friction) stops speeding up at this multiple
level 2 damage multiplier (Magicraft spells grow 1.3-2.5x per level)
a projectile that has slowed below this share of its start speed has stopped: it ends there (and explodes if it explodes), as in Noita where a spent projectile lands
